description: Mod Menu as a compact grid: per-tile configure buttons, favorites, hiding, and a classic-view switch

mods.name: Grid Menu
mods.description: Replaces the Mod Menu mods list with a compact grid of tiles.

releases.notes:
Grid Menu 1.1.0 for Fabric, Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2 (Mod Menu 18 and 20).

Requires Fabric API, Cloth Config and Mod Menu. Client-side only.

## What is new since 1.0.0

- F8 privacy lock for screen sharing: hidden mods become fully invisible and uncounted in the grid, the classic list and search, while the hide feature keeps working normally on top. F8 again restores them.
- Favorites section with a star on hover, persistent grid/classic preference with a switch in both screens, and a header count of shown and hidden mods.

## Install

Drop the jar in your mods folder next to Fabric API, Cloth Config and Mod Menu.
